values.note: $25 a night at Sawmill Road (no electric; $24 off-peak); full hookups at Big Muskie $50 all year, the same on a Saturday. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. Hook Lake, Maple Grove and Sand Hollow are no-fee, first-come primitive areas. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

note: Sand Hollow (Campground C) on Horse Run Lake has primitive (no-hookup) sites right on the water that allow RVs/trailers, not just tents; small-medium rigs park on gravel/grass. Hook Lake (Campground A) is also RV-friendly with near-water sites. Former AEP ReCreation Land. Big Muskie, the full-hookup campground, is about 3.9 km east of Sand Hollow and not on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 base/+$25 FHU. Hookups changed none -> 50A/water/sewer (Big Muskie). Added 79 reservable sites, 75 ft max, showers etc., year-round, $6.50 fee. SPLIT and waterfront questions flagged; stored pin is at Sand Hollow, not at either paid campground.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: this one entry holds five camping areas at separate places, each with its own ODNR street address. Big Muskie (100 Natural Resources Rd 1, 48 plotted sites, centroid 39.73668,-81.68602), Sawmill Road (10390 N SR 83; ReserveOhio gives only a facility point 39.7377,-81.6900, about 300 m from Big Muskie, and its sites carry no coordinates), Hook Lake (9160 N SR 83, youth-only ponds), Sand Hollow (9290 SR 284; the stored pin, and The Dyrt's point 39.7349,-81.7317) and Maple Grove (7580 SR 284). MEASURED: stored pin to Big Muskie's centroid 3.86 km. I did not locate Hook Lake's or Maple Grove's sites on the ground, so those distances are unmeasured. Sawmill and Big Muskie may be one split or two: their entrances differ by address, but ODNR's region map draws them close together.

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront rests only on Sand Hollow, a no-fee area): ODNR: 'It borders Horse Run Lake... Several sites border the lake', 'primitive (no water, no electric, no pad)'. Big Muskie plots in a wooded valley with no lake or pond at its pads; 'lakefront' does not describe the paid campground this entry's fees and hookups now describe. No per-site data or leaf-off view of Sand Hollow's sites was available: imagery at the pin shows the lake's south end, a small lot and a gravel road running north along the shore under canopy.

SAND HOLLOW FIT, from Campendium reviewers' stated rigs (not operator data): 22-ft travel trailer at site 84, 2024-05-05; 26-ft travel trailer at site 43, 2021-09-20, who still wrote 'Sites are mostly full shade and very unlevel. Suited mostly for tents, vans and very small campers.'; 21-ft Class B at sites 50-51, 2021-09-08 ('Sites 50 and 51 are joined in a loop drive with mostly level spots'); 36-ft fifth wheel, 2020-09-02 ('numbered sites... first come, first-served... Registration is required at the on-site kiosk'). A 2022-05-16 reviewer at site 81: 'about a 1.5 mile walk to the front where there's a lake', so not every site is at the water. The newest report of a rig 23 ft or longer is 2021. ODNR states no length there. The stored note's 'small-medium rigs park on gravel/grass' and 'Hook Lake... RV-friendly' have no operator source; ODNR's word for all three no-fee areas is 'no pad', and Hook Lake's water is youth-only fishing ponds. I left that text in the note.

BOOKING NOT WRITTEN (manual value): stored fcfs 'always' and its note were read from the reservation policy, which still says 'Jesse Owens State Park is the only park that offers first-come, first-served camping with on-site registration'. But the campground page says Big Muskie 'Reservations are required' and Sawmill sites are 'fee-based and reservable'; only the three no-fee areas are first-come. 'some_sites' would be accurate. The note's 'worth driving to without a booking' holds for the free areas only. MaxStay is 14 on ReserveOhio and ODNR gives a two-week maximum at the no-fee areas.
$50 FULL HOOKUP: Big Muskie's rate is $50 all year. The price gate is private-only, so no criteria issue.
